label: For "eSIM Activation Risk Scoring": Score eSIM and SIM-swap activation requests for takeover risk in real time so genuine customers are served quickly and risky activations get step-up verification. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Counting verification failures as fraud.
